name: Electromotive Force (emf)
description: The amount of energy (W) provided per unit charge (Q) to move round the complete circuit.

name: Electrical Power
description: The rate of transfer of electrical energy (E) over a given time (t).

name: Joule's Law
description: The amount of heat (H) produced is directly proportional to the square of the current (I), the value of resistance (R), and the time taken (t).
